record.question: Calculate SHP (Shaft Horse Power) required of clear water and capacity of the pump driving motor for the following data. Rate of water supply = 70 lpcd, Population = 20,000 souls, Static head = 420 m, Head losses due to friction, bend, valves etc = 30 m, Combined efficiency = 70%, Assuming 16 hours of pumping per day. Use the formula: Shaft Horse Power = (Q × H × Specific gravity) / (75 × n), Where Q = discharge in litre/sec, H = Total head in metres, n = Pump efficiency. Take specific gravity = 1. Add 10% for pump requiring more than 75 kW and add 2% for elevation effect.
